description: Adds and/or removes labels on a message in one call. Moving changes the message id; the new id is returned.

addLabelIds.description: Label ids: STARRED, UNREAD, INBOX, TRASH, SPAM, or a user label id from list_labels. Adding a folder label moves the message to that folder (one folder per message); removing the current folder label moves it back to INBOX.

name: update_message_labels
